unit.name: Monkey D. Luffy
unit.summary: A ranged damage captain adaptation of Monkey D. Luffy from the original One Piece manga continuity. His Gum-Gum Pistol provides dependable stretched-arm pressure, while three independent upgrade paths specialize in sustained elastic fire, Haki burst and control, or slower high-impact Gear-inspired attacks. Gear techniques are represented as selected automatic attacks rather than runtime transformations.

actions.name: Gum-Gum Pistol
actions.summary: Luffy stretches and slingshots his arm as a recurring ranged punch. Its projectile speed is fixed; Elastic Rush upgrades its reach, recurring cadence, shot count and collateral cap separately.

actions.name: Haki Emission
actions.summary: A separate automatic short-range Haki blast adapted from Luffy's Emission technique. It is locked until Haki Command tier 2 and deals direct line-strike damage without claiming penetration.

actions.name: Gum-Gum Gigant
actions.summary: A slow automatic direct strike inspired by Gear 3's enlarged high-damage attacks. It represents the characteristic attack without runtime enlargement or post-use shrinking.

actions.name: Compressed Kong Gun
actions.summary: A slower direct strike adapting Gear 4's compressed-release blows. It emphasizes a separate high-damage attack and does not model transformation, flight or generic defensive coating.

actions.name: Freedom Impact
actions.summary: A slow chain attack inspired by Gear 5's awakened freedom. It strikes distinct eligible targets within range with equal damage and does not claim environmental rubberization, living-target conversion or runtime awakening.

actions.name: Conqueror's Haki
actions.summary: A manually invoked aura that stuns eligible weak-willed enemies for a short duration. Status immunity and resistance are supplied by game context.

abilities.name: Conqueror's Haki
abilities.summary: Manually activate Conqueror's Haki to stun up to eight eligible weak-willed enemies in a 20-unit aura. It is the unit's sole native active ability and has a 30-second cooldown.

paths.name: Elastic Rush
paths.summary: Sustained ranged pressure through longer reach, faster recurring attacks, additional shots and limited collateral targeting.

paths.name: Haki Command
paths.summary: Burst and control through Armament damage, a separate Emission attack and one manual Conqueror's Haki ability.

paths.name: Gears as Attacks
paths.summary: Slower, high-impact characteristic attacks inspired by Gear 3, Gear 4 and Gear 5 without runtime transformations.

nodes.name: Stretching Reach
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol's attack range from 30 to 38 world units.

nodes.name: Gear 2 Circulation
nodes.summary: Reduce Gum-Gum Pistol's scheduled recurring period from 0.80 to 0.68 seconds. This improves cadence, not projectile travel speed.

nodes.name: Double Slingshot
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol's projectiles per cycle from 1 to 2, adding a second shot rather than collateral pierce.

nodes.name: Accelerated Pump
nodes.summary: Reduce Gum-Gum Pistol's scheduled recurring period from 0.68 to 0.58 seconds for further sustained pressure. This remains a cadence upgrade, not projectile speed.

nodes.name: Rubber Ricochet
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol's collateral target cap from 1 to 2, allowing each projectile to hit one additional eligible target.

nodes.name: Armament Imprint
nodes.summary: Add a 6-hit-point direct Haki damage effect to Gum-Gum Pistol, adapting Armament Haki's offensive coating without adding defense or generic stat modification.

nodes.name: Emission
nodes.summary: Enable Haki Emission as a separate automatic 24-unit line-strike attack with a 1.50-second recurring period.

nodes.name: Internal Destruction Adaptation
nodes.summary: Increase Haki Emission's direct damage from 10 to 18 hit points. Penetration and internal destruction are not modeled as unsupported mechanics.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Haki
nodes.summary: Grant the sole native manual active ability, allowing a 20-unit aura to stun up to eight eligible weak-willed enemies.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Coating
nodes.summary: Increase the existing Armament Imprint effect on Gum-Gum Pistol from 6 to 12 hit points. This is a bounded damage increase, not a defensive stat modifier.

nodes.name: Gum-Gum Gigant
nodes.summary: Enable the slow automatic Gum-Gum Gigant direct strike inspired by Gear 3's enlarged attacks.

nodes.name: Enlarged Impact
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Gigant's direct damage from 26 to 38 hit points.

nodes.name: Compressed Kong Gun
nodes.summary: Enable the separate 26-unit Compressed Kong Gun direct strike adapting Gear 4's compression-based power.

nodes.name: Haki Compression
nodes.summary: Increase Compressed Kong Gun's direct damage from 34 to 52 hit points while leaving its delivery and cadence unchanged.

nodes.name: Freedom Impact
nodes.summary: Enable Freedom Impact as a slow 32-unit chain attack, then raise its collateral cap from 1 to 3 distinct eligible targets including the first.

visuals.description: Straw hat, red vest, blue shorts and sandals consistent with Monkey D. Luffy's recognizable manga design.
The attacking arm visibly stretches backward and snaps forward during Gum-Gum Pistol.
Dark Haki coating and sharp emission accents appear on Haki attacks.
Gum-Gum Gigant, Compressed Kong Gun and Freedom Impact use distinct enlarged, compressed and exuberant impact silhouettes without changing the unit's runtime form.

animations.description: Luffy braces, stretches one arm and launches a slingshot punch.
Luffy thrusts a coated hand forward and releases a compact Haki blast.
Luffy stands firm as a short aura pulse radiates outward with a dominating visual shockwave.
A large direct punch lands with a heavy, enlarged impact pose.
Luffy compresses and releases a powerful forward blow with a dense impact burst.
A playful, highly elastic strike bounces through successive targets without implying environmental transformation.

audio.description: Elastic snap followed by a forceful punch impact.
Low resonant Haki crackle and compressed blast report.
Deep shockwave pulse with a brief stunned-enemy sting.
Distinct heavy impact sounds for enlarged, compressed and chained attacks.

issues.message: Unexpected token 'I', "Increase G"... is not valid JSON

findings.evidence: The supplied diagnostic measured only 0.006768 relative utility gain for Stretching Reach across all six scenarios. The only observed difference was one fewer targeting failure in the fast scenario; all other scenario observables were unchanged.
findings.change: Increase the tier-1 range gain from 30 to 45 world units so the upgrade has a more executable reach breakpoint while preserving the stretched-arm identity.

findings.evidence: Ability integration measured 0.5, with 0/1 abilities meeting the integration threshold. Role consistency also reported a control signal of 0, and sampled scenarios recorded no status uptime. The supplied diagnostic limits state that manual abilities use a separate invocation path, so this result does not prove the ability is mechanically inactive during manual play.
findings.change: No executable patch is justified. Converting Conqueror's Haki to an automatic action would remove the intended manual player decision; retain the manual ability and treat its automated-scenario utility as unresolved.

uncertainties: The range adjustment is based on uncalibrated sampled diagnostics rather than a complete balance simulation; its utility in scenarios not supplied remains uncertain.
The Conqueror's Haki findings cannot distinguish absent manual invocation from weak control performance because the supplied simulations do not establish manual ability execution coverage.

limits: Source fidelity review remains model judgment. Diagnostics are uncalibrated mechanical evidence.
A rejected or failed review preserves the draft; structural success does not mean the review succeeded.
Only complete valid transactions are committed. Large redesigns and missing top-level structures may remain unrepaired.
Feasibility and source attribution remain model judgments. A supported claim in the plan is not an independent verification of the final implementation.

plan.identity: Monkey D. Luffy, One Piece manga continuity. Public design specification and feasibility report: a single-placement 600-credit ranged damage unit using Gum-Gum Pistol as its readable base attack. The design is feasible under classic-three-path: three independent five-tier paths, legal 5/2 crosspathing, one native manual ability, one control mechanic, no damage-over-time mechanic, and zero forms, totaling two of three

baseAttack.description: Gum-Gum Pistol: Luffy stretches and slingshots his arm as a recurring ranged punch. The base action uses one fixed-speed projectile, one shot per cycle, one target, and an initial 0.80-second attack period; later upgrades explicitly distinguish cadence, extra shots, collateral targets, and projectile travel speed.

paths.name: Elastic Rush
paths.role: Damage; choose this path for sustained ranged pressure, faster recurring attacks, extra shots, and limited collateral targeting.
progression: Tier 1 — Stretching Reach: increase Gum-Gum Pistol range from 30 to 38 world units.
Tier 2 — Gear 2-inspired Circulation: reduce the recurring attack period from 0.80 to 0.68 seconds; this is a shorter attack period, not faster projectile travel.
Tier 3 — Double Slingshot: increase projectilesPerCycle from 1 to 2; this adds shots, not collateral pierce.
Tier 4 — Accelerated Pump: reduce the recurring attack period from 0.68 to 0.58 seconds; this is cadence only, not projectile speed.
Tier 5 — Rubber Ricochet: increase maximumTargetsPerProjectile from 1 to 2; this adds one collateral target, not an additional shot.

paths.name: Haki Command
paths.role: Burst/control; choose this path for direct Haki damage, a secondary emission attack, and a single manual Conqueror's Haki control ability.

Tier 2 — Emission: enable Haki Emission as a separate automatic line-strike action at 24 world units.
Tier 3 — Internal Destruction adaptation: increase Haki Emission's direct-damage effect; penetration and internal destruction are not implemented.
Tier 4 — Conqueror's Haki: grant the sole native manual active ability, affecting eligible weak-willed enemies in an aura.
Tier 5 — Conqueror's Coating: increase the existing Armament Imprint damage effect on Gum-Gum Pistol; this is damage, not a defensive stat modifier.

paths.role: Burst; choose this path for slower, high-damage characteristic attacks. These are enabled actions, not runtime transformations or forms.

progression: Tier 1 — Gum-Gum Gigant: enable a 2.20-second automatic direct-strike action at 18 world units, inspired by Gear 3's enlarged high-damage attacks.
Tier 2 — Enlarged Impact: increase Gum-Gum Gigant's direct-damage effect.
Tier 3 — Compressed Kong Gun: enable a 3.00-second automatic direct-strike action at 26 world units, adapting Gear 4's compressed-release blows.
Tier 4 — Haki Compression: increase Compressed Kong Gun's direct-damage effect; its air propulsion and flight behavior are not modeled.

Tier 5 — Freedom Impact: enable a 4.50-second automatic chain action at 32 world units with a maximum of 3 distinct targets, adapting a Gear 5-style freedom attack without awakening or environmental rubberization.

mechanics.name: Gum-Gum Pistol
mechanics.implementation: Enabled primary interval action. Projectile delivery, 30-world-unit range, fixed projectileSpeedWorldUnitsPerSecond, one projectile per cycle, maximum one target initially, 0.80-second cooldown/period. Elastic Rush owns its mutable range, cadence, shot count, and collateral cap.

mechanics.name: Armament Haki Imprint
mechanics.implementation: Tier-1 Haki Command add-effect on Gum-Gum Pistol. Applies direct damage only; it does not claim defense increase, generic stat modification, Devil Fruit negation, or protected-target interaction.

mechanics.name: Haki Emission
mechanics.implementation: Locked automatic line-strike action enabled at Haki Command tier 2, with 24-world-unit range and a 1.50-second cooldown. Tier 3 modifies only its direct-damage effect; no penetration parameter is introduced.

mechanics.name: Conqueror's Haki
mechanics.implementation: Locked manual active ability granted at Haki Command tier 4. One native ability, one charge, no resource cost, 30-second cooldown. Aura delivery uses a 20-world-unit radius, targets only enemies tagged weak-willed, caps applications at 8 targets, and applies unconscious for 2.0 seconds with one stack and no refresh. Immunity and resistance come from supplied game context.

mechanics.name: Gum-Gum Gigant
mechanics.implementation: Locked automatic direct-strike action enabled at Gears as Attacks tier 1. It uses an 18-world-unit range, 2.20-second cooldown, and a finite direct-damage effect. It is a characteristic attack adaptation, not a Gear 3 form.

mechanics.name: Compressed Kong Gun
mechanics.implementation: Locked automatic direct-strike action enabled at Gears as Attacks tier 3. It uses a 26-world-unit range, 3.00-second cooldown, and finite direct damage. It adapts Gear 4 compression and power without runtime inflation, flight, or transformation.

mechanics.name: Freedom Impact
mechanics.implementation: Locked automatic chain action enabled at Gears as Attacks tier 5. It uses 32-world-unit range, 4.50-second cooldown, and a maximum of 3 distinct targets including the first; every hit uses the same effect amount. It adapts an awakened attack without a form, environmental conversion, living-target rubberization, or imagination-driven rules.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 2's runtime body transformation, substantial strain, rapid energy consumption, and possible lifespan shortening.
omissions.reason: Runtime transformations are excluded, and no self-damage or unsupported lifespan mechanic is added. Gear 2 is honestly adapted only as Elastic Rush cadence upgrades.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 3's runtime enlargement and original post-use shrinking drawback.
omissions.reason: Gum-Gum Gigant is an enabled characteristic attack rather than a form; the source's temporary body state and shrink recovery are omitted.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 4's inflated-muscle transformation, Armament coating as a body state, compression-based movement, and airborne propulsion comparable to Moon Walk.
omissions.reason: Compressed Kong Gun preserves the attack's compression/power distinction but omits runtime transformation and flight because forms and runtime movement transformations are unsupported here.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 5's awakened transformation, white hair and clothes, fatal-blow awakening trigger, imagination-limited freedom, joy aura, and environmental or living-being rubberization.
omissions.reason: Forms are encounter selections only and cannot runtime-transform, trigger, revert, or safely encode arbitrary imagination. Freedom Impact is an explicit attack adaptation; the remaining distinctions are omitted.

omissions.sourceTrait: Rubber immunity to electricity, blunt-force resistance, vulnerability to sharp weapons, and loss of strength or independent movement in water or around Sea-Prism Stone.
omissions.reason: Generic defensive stat modifiers, damage-type immunities, and context-specific incapacitation are not represented in this compact executable subset.

omissions.sourceTrait: Luffy's immense baseline strength, durability, speed, reflexes, agility, endurance, and stamina.
omissions.reason: Generic stat modifiers are outside the default contract; only explicit attack effects and cadence are modeled.

omissions.sourceTrait: Observation Haki, Future Sight, and their movement-reading or several-seconds-ahead behavior.
omissions.reason: Passive/reactive scheduling and predictive combat behavior are unsupported. No false reveal or evasion mechanic is claimed.

omissions.sourceTrait: Full Armament Haki defense, Devil Fruit defense negation, and Internal Destruction's penetration of targets or objects.
omissions.reason: Armament is adapted to direct attack damage, while defense modification, defense negation, and penetration effects are not declared capabilities.

omissions.sourceTrait: Luffy's partial poison immunity and slow susceptibility to strong poison.
omissions.reason: No poison-status contract or resistance parameter is supplied, so the trait remains unimplemented rather than being invented.

omissions.sourceTrait: Crew, family, affiliations, captaincy, liberation history, World Government conflict, Four Emperor status, Grand Fleet size, and bounty progression.
omissions.reason: These are narrative, social, roster, or economy-context facts rather than executable unit mechanics in this specification.

uncertainties: No gameplay intent or constraints were supplied, so the selected combat subset does not claim a preferred role beyond the required three-path structure.
Exact attack periods, ranges, ability cooldown, status duration, and purchase cost are neutral design values, not source facts; balance is not established.

Projectile travel speed remains fixed because the supplied upgrade vocabulary cannot directly modify projectileSpeedWorldUnitsPerSecond. Elastic Rush changes recurring period, projectilesPerCycle, and maximumTargetsPerProjectile as separate properties.
The weak-willed target tag and all status immunity or resistance behavior must be supplied by the consuming game's context.
The design declares one ability and no forms; therefore it stays below the prominent-mechanic limit while preserving executable attacks for selected Gear distinctions.
Strictly increasing positive node prices and final reference validation remain implementation obligations for the eventual DSL serialization.

effectiveLimits.prominentMechanicCounting: Every declared ability plus every declared form plus one if control is used plus one if damage-over-time is used. Locked declarations still count. Resources do not directly count, but their associated abilities and forms do.

forms.requirements: empty; grant-form upgrade or explicit external unlock

effectiveLimits.formLimitations: Forms are external encounter selections. They do not switch at runtime, revert, enforce mutually exclusive modes, or make arbitrary combinations safe. A grant-form upgrade unlocks a later external build selection.
effectiveLimits.intervalCadence: For an enabled primary interval action, scheduled period = max(trigger.intervalSeconds, timing.cooldownSeconds). A fixed trigger interval can mask cooldown upgrades. A trigger floor of 0.15 seconds allows cooldown upgrades down to that floor; use a different explicit interval only when intentional. Windup delays resolution separately.
effectiveLimits.delivery: Direct-strike and line-strike can have range up to the same configured maximum as projectiles. Melee does not imply short range. Projectile primary aim count and collateral pierce are separate; do not infer a combined minimum target cap.

projectileSpeed.implementation: A speed change needs a separately declared replacement action with a different projectileSpeedWorldUnitsPerSecond and a valid replace-action operation, or an honestly revised progression. Replacement must satisfy all existing reference, ownership and lifecycle rules.

parameterMeaning.cooldownSeconds: Time gate between action invocations; recurring scheduling also uses trigger.intervalSeconds.
parameterMeaning.emitterCount: Number of emitters, not travel speed.
parameterMeaning.projectilesPerCycle: Shots emitted per cycle, not projectile travel speed.
parameterMeaning.maximumTargetsPerProjectile: Collateral target/pierce limit, not projectile travel speed.

uncheckedRules: Character fidelity and prose/mechanic agreement require review.
The consuming game must implement these mechanics.
Runtime reachability, numerical balance and enjoyable progression are not established.
